name: Specular Radiance Calculation
aliases: Indirect Specular Radiance via Cone Tracing
definition: Calculates specular radiance based on camera position and surface reflection, which cannot be precomputed in a voxel texture.
summary: Specular radiance calculation determines real-time, view-dependent specular contributions in volume rendering by splitting the process into indirect specular radiance via cone tracing and direct specular radiance via geometric visibility.
